name: Ring of Shooting Stars

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Ball Lightning
powers.text: 2 charges: a crackling sphere of lightning bursts on a point within 120 ft (Dex DC 15, 4d12 Lightning, half on a success).

powers.name: Shooting Stars
powers.text: 1 to 3 charges: a glowing mote per charge streaks to a point within 60 ft; creatures there make a Dex save (DC 15) or take 4d4 Fire per mote (half on a success).

summary: 6 charges: Faerie Fire, ball lightning and shooting stars; Dancing Lights and Light at will in the dark.
text: While wearing this ring in Dim Light or darkness, you can cast Dancing Lights and Light from the ring at will. The ring has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend 1 charge to cast Faerie Fire (save DC 15). Ball Lightning: you can expend 2 charges to create a sphere of lightning at a point within 120 feet; each creature within 5 feet of it makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d12 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. Shooting Stars: you can expend 1 to 3 charges; for each charge, a mote of light streaks to a point within 60 feet, and each creature in a 15-foot cube there makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d4 Fire damage per mote on a failed save or half as much on a success.
